This '''unknown individual''' was a lean [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Adumari]] man with an artificial leg, the result of being hit with shrapnel from his own [[Blade-28 fighter|Blade-28]] after ejecting from the disintegrating fighter.<ref name="soa" />

During [[Red Flight]]'s&mdash;which consisted of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]&mdash;diplomatic visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] , he invited them to his [[Home of Cartann's Minister of Trade|home]] on the nation of [[Cartann]]for dinner where he had them tell him their exploits.<ref name="soa" />
